title: evaluate() raises ZeroDivisionError instead of reporting a bad expression
body:
Dividing by zero blows up with a raw `ZeroDivisionError` instead of the `ValueError` the docstring promises for invalid input.

Steps to reproduce:

```bash
pip install pytest
python -m pytest tests/test_evaluate.py -x
```

Output:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/test_evaluate.py", line 21, in test_divide_by_zero
    assert evaluate("6 / 0") == 0
  File "src/tinycalc/evaluate.py", line 27, in evaluate
    total = total // value
ZeroDivisionError: integer division or modulo by zero
```

Expected: a `ValueError` naming the offending expression.
